items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: I had some good players, I had Chet Baker there and Al Cohn and David Schnitter come in and played with Pepper Adams.

ctx.x: Yeah. They were both called Renaissance. The first one was The Renaissance and the other one was The Renaissance Two. I had some good players, I had Chet Baker there and Al Cohn and David Schnitter come in and played with Pepper Adams. I had some good people there but nobody would come to hear them. They did come to hear Chet and they did come to hear Don, they disregarded whatever area it was from you know. So Chet Baker was there for three days and it was mobbed every night. I charged seven dollars at the door…
